comparison_protocol_notes: Same PNY RTX 5070 Ti, driver617.42 and300W limit; i7-5820K6c12t versus i7-5960X8c16t. One repeat each: descriptive, not a controlled causal or significance claim.
Only the established thirteen models are published: ten LM Studio variants and three Strata variants,156 matching cells,one repeat. No additional models are included.
Native96K context, effective GPU expert cache and full pinned/locked host placement match the reference. Automatic CPU worker selection can change; Qwen thread counts are observed from engine logs.
Single-client prefill/decode board watts and joules are measured. Concurrent whole-case group energy includes prefill, decoding and queueing; it is never decode-only energy.
System energy is estimated as GPU+60W+140W*CPU utilization. Utilization denominator changes12to16 logical cores; this cannot establish measured CPU efficiency.
Fixed six-worker RAM copy is compared with six workers. Automatic eight-worker throughput is a separate observation. Copy bandwidth is payload throughput, not measured memory-controller traffic.

GPU compute and VRAM-copy results were first measured on the5960X setup; no matching5820K baseline exists and no CPU gain is inferred. FP16 requested FP32 compute allows unspecified partial-reduction precision; INT8 usesTOPS and INT4 is unavailable.
MTP requested does not prove effective drafting; engine-lifetime counters include warmups and Flash suffix drafts. Qwen sampling preserves the reference presence penalty.
No controlled SATA/NVMe inference sweep was performed. Actual source telemetry, configuration fingerprints, sessions, failures and original snapshots are preserved.
